title.hr: down i out: kada Ceph kopira
title.en: down vs out: when Ceph copies

concept.hr: down: degradirano, ništa se ne miče; out nakon intervala: preraspodjela
concept.en: down: degraded, nothing moves; out after a timer: rebalancing

summary.hr: Zaustavi OSD i pusti da vrijeme teče: pao je, ali unutra, pa se ništa ne miče; izbačen nakon 600 s, pa oporavak. noout, povratak i pražnjenje.
summary.en: Stop an OSD and let time pass: down but in, nothing moves; out after 600 s, then recovery. With noout, a return in time, a late return and a drain.
